name: COUNTY OF FLOYD
ai_summary: The 2025 audit has three findings on federal awards, two of them serious, all touching the Coronavirus State and Local Fiscal Recovery Fund. None is a repeat or is flagged with questioned costs, and 2023 and 2024 have no federal award findings on file, so the rubric gives medium, not high. All three audits also disclosed a material weakness in the financial statements, with no finding text to explain it.

name: SHENANDOAH AREA AGENCY ON AGING, INC
ai_summary: Draft rating: medium. The latest audit (2024) has one finding, and it is a repeat: the year-end report to the state aging agency did not match the accounting records, the same problem as in 2023. It is not a serious finding and has no questioned costs, but the 2024 audit also disclosed a financial-statement material weakness that has no finding text here, and no 2025 audit is on file.

name: WYTHEVILLE REDEVELOPMENT & HOUSING AUTHORITY
ai_summary: Medium risk. The 2025 audit has one finding, which the auditor marked as a material weakness (the most serious grade of control problem): about 44% of tested housing voucher files lacked required signatures. It is not a repeat, has no questioned costs, and the 2023 and 2024 audits had no findings. I did not raise the rating to high, but the reviewer should confirm that call, because the finding covers two voucher programs and is traced to staff turnover.

name: Middle Peninsula Planning District Commission
ai_summary: Draft rating: high. The 2024 audit, the only one on file for 2023 to 2025, has three findings that the auditor marked as material weaknesses (the most serious kind of control failure), which gives medium under the rubric. I moved it up one level because the auditor traces all three to finance staff turnover and missing controls across the accounting function.

name: NEW RIVER VALLEY COMMUNITY SERVICES
ai_summary: The 2024 audit (the latest on file) has two findings, both for late filing and neither marked serious, which is a low rating on the flags alone. I moved it up one level to medium because the auditor traces both to vacant finance department posts, including the Senior Finance Director, and the lateness touches more than one federal program. Separately, the 2024 audit disclosed a material weakness (a serious control gap) in the financial statements, with no finding text in the data to explain it.
